description: This file defines a controller class 'Notification' for the admin cron module in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It sets up a scheduled task related to system notifications or currency updates.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: A controller class within the OpenCart admin cron module responsible for scheduling a 'currency' task.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up a scheduled task with code 'currency' and action 'task/system/notification', then adds it via the model.
